title: Watch Collection Service Interval Aging
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:item
| search service_due_date=*
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by watch_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which watchess have gone quiet for watch service records.
value: Aging since service matters because the watch that is rarely worn is also easy to forget maintaining.
implementation: Send watch service records events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of watchess with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which watchess have gone quiet longer than they should for watch service records.
